ITEM 1 | Pale cream-to-white cubed or chunked pieces with slightly browned edges, firm and dense, about 2-3 cm pieces, scattered across the lower and right side of the bowl | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale green avocado slices and chunks with buttery, slightly glossy surfaces, some still with a bright green skin edge, about 4-6 cm wedges, mostly along the upper left rim | 70
ITEM 3 | Thin shaved and shard-like pieces of hard pale yellow cheese with slightly crystalline edges and a matte, dry surface, about 3-5 cm long and 1 cm thick, piled on top of the greens in the center | 45
ITEM 4 | Mixed fresh salad greens including dark green spinach-like leaves, lighter green romaine-style pieces and some wilted edges, crisp and moist-looking, filling most of the bowl | 80
ITEM 5 | Green broccoli florets, bright green with small rounded clusters about 2-3 cm across, scattered among the greens on the upper and right side | 25
ITEM 6 | Small pink-red thin shreds, likely a few fine strands with a glossy surface, about 3-4 cm long, lying near the left-center of the greens | 2
